description:
*Thinking about using your retirement savings to buy a business?* ROBS _(Rollover for Business Startups)_ financing lets you tap into your 401(k) or IRA without penalties, taxes, or monthly loan payments. *Guidant Financial* is one of the most established names in ROBS financing—helping entrepreneurs fund over $3 billion in businesses since 2003.

In this video, we break down:

- How ROBS financing actually works
- The real costs _(setup fees, ongoing compliance, and hidden risks)_
- Who should _(and shouldn't)_ consider ROBS
- How it compares to traditional SBA loans
- What happens if your business fails

*Ready to explore ROBS financing with Guidant Financial?* 

Apply here: https://www.gfprequal.com/mc

ROBS isn't for everyone—but if you've got the retirement funds and you're buying a proven, cash-flowing business, it could be a game changer. Just make sure you understand the compliance requirements and long-term risks before you jump in.

*💡 Want more funding strategies?* Subscribe for weekly breakdowns on business loans, alternative financing, and acquisition tactics for serious entrepreneurs.
